text:
alex: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for metrics-pipeline: log_ingest_queue_lag_high — 95th pctl queue depth > 120s across ingest-fanout cluster
incident-bot: ALERT: metrics-pipeline/log_ingest_queue_lag_high fired (severity: P1). PagerDuty incident #PD-7832 created and notified @oncall.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident PD-7832 assigned to oncall schedule eng-sre-primary.
maria: acked. I'm on it, pulling logs now.
alex: thanks. initial note: happening right after a deploy to ingest-fanout v2.3.0 ~5m ago. Could be consumer parallelism change or a bad config.
jin: seeing elevated CPU and GC on fanout-03, backlog steady at ~140s.
sam: any customer impact?
maria: not yet reported, but some internal backfills delayed. A subset of downstream metrics missing in dashboards (k8s node exporter scrape gaps) — correlates with ingest delays.
alex: good call. Maria, can you run a quick consumer-lag query? `sum(rate(log_ingest_queue_length[30s])) by (consumer)` and `max_over_time(log_ingest_processing_time[5m])`
maria: running... output: `fanout-01: 28s, fanout-02: 35s, fanout-03: 142s` and `processing_time max ~3.6s on fanout-03`
jin: fanout-03 running on older instance type (mismatch) after autoscaler placement. I see degraded NIC throughput too.
alex: possible noisy neighbor or instance packing. Can we spin up a replacement and remap traffic?
sam: if we can autoscale immediately it's fastest. Maria, can you bump fanout replicas + add 1 consumer group?
maria: scaling +1 on fanout-* now via k8s: `kubectl scale deploy/ingest-fanout --replicas=6 -n infra`
incident-bot: Deployment scale request accepted. New pods starting.
jin: kicked a manual drain of fanout-03 to move its load: `kubectl cordon fanout-03 && kubectl drain fanout-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
sam: heads-up: draining may temporarily requeue messages; ensure duplicate protection downstream.
maria: rolling drain done, new pods came up on faster instances. Monitoring queue depth...
alex: also toggle sampling to reduce ingestion pressure temporarily: set log_ingest_sampling to 0.7 for trial. Maria apply?
maria: applied sampling=0.7 via feature flag.
jin: immediate drop in incoming QPS by ~28%. backlog trending down to ~60s.
alex: great. Any sign of config regression from the deploy?
maria: digging into release diff: fanout config changed `max_inflight` from 256 -> 1024 to speed throughput; seems okay but combined with instance type mismatch led to CPU/network thrash.
sam: we should rollback that change in the chart for next patch. For now, keep sampling and extra replicas.
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-7832 acknowledged by maria.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: PD-7832 acknowledged at 2026-03-14T14:02:12Z by maria.
alex: putting a safety limit: set max_inflight to 512 via helm patch to stabilize. maria, can you patch and rollout canary to fanout-04 first?
maria: patching helm: `helm upgrade ingest-fanout ./charts/ingest --set max_inflight=512 --namespace infra --reuse-values --wait --timeout 5m --set canary.host=fanout-04`
jin: logs show processed backlog dropping below 20s now. CPU normalized.
sam: good. What's the expected timeline to full recovery?
maria: with current settings, estimate 8-12 minutes to clear backlog. Keeping sampling 0.7 for additional 15m to be safe.
alex: I'll update the incident ticket and send a quick note to product about temporary degraded dashboards. Sam, can you handle customer comms if anything escalates?
sam: on it, drafting a note: "We detected temporary ingestion delays affecting metric dashboards; mitigation in progress; no data loss expected."
incident-bot: PD-7832 status: acknowledged -> monitoring
alex: follow-up action items: 1) rollback max_inflight increase in next patch, 2) enforce instance type constraint in autoscaler, 3) add early warning alert for NIC saturation per node. Assign owners?
maria: I'll own #1 and #3.
jin: I'll own #2 (autoscaler constraints).
sam: I'll finish customer note and close comms loop.
alex: thumbs up. If backlog stays <30s by last_message_ts we'll close PD. Keep thread updates concise.
maria: backlog at ~12s, sampling still on. Keeping an eye for 20m.
jin: verifying no other fanout pods with high NIC. all good.
incident-bot: PD-7832: Resolved -> closed by maria at 2026-03-14T14:18:20Z.
pagerduty: PagerDuty: PD-7832 resolved.
maria: closing thread. summary: root cause was combined config change (max_inflight) + instance placement on slower host causing CPU/NIC bottleneck. Mitigation: scale replicas, cordon/drain bad host, temporarily lower sampling and patch max_inflight to 512. Postmortem and follow-ups assigned. :white_check_mark:
